app.name: Arya Vysya Vamsha Vruksham
app.tagline: The verified family tree of the Arya Vysya community

home.heroBody: Record your ancestors, gotra, family name and native place. Every member is endorsed by their local sangha or sabha and verified by the district in-charge, and each family keeps its own branch accurate.
home.step1Body: Create an account and tell us your family details and district.
home.step2Body: Your local sangha / sabha endorses you, and the district in-charge confirms you belong to the family and links you to the tree.
home.step3Body: Edit your own family up to 5 generations above and below you.
home.pendingNotice: Your membership is waiting for verification by the {district} district in-charge.
home.eyebrow: The verified Arya Vysya family tree
home.gotraStrip: {count} gotras, each with its kula names in four scripts
home.featuresTitle: Everything a vamsham needs, kept together
home.featuresSub: Built with the sanghas and sabhas, for the way our families actually record lineage.
home.f1Body: Every member is endorsed by their local sangha or sabha and confirmed by the district in-charge before they see a single tree.
home.f2Body: Own, birth and mother's gotra are tracked for everyone. A wife takes her husband's gotra on marriage and her birth gotra is never lost.
home.f3Body: Sagotra, the mother's gotra and close blood relations are checked against your region's rules, so elders can decide with the facts.
home.f4Title: Native place down to the village
home.f4Body: State, district, taluk, village and pincode, from the official directories, so families from the same ooru find each other.
home.f5Body: Search by name, gotra, kula or native place, in English, Telugu, Kannada or Tamil.
home.f6Title: A picture of your whole lineage
home.f6Body: See the family as a growing banyan, as a list by generation, or as a chart, from the eldest known ancestor down.
home.howTitle: From your name to your whole lineage
home.privacyTitle: Your family's details stay in the family
home.privacyBody: Only verified members can see the trees. Photos are optional, hidden by default for women and decided by guardians for minors. Every change is recorded, and duplicate records are caught before they are made.
home.ctaBody: Join, get endorsed by your local sangha, and start adding the generations you remember. The ones after you will thank you.

rules.intro: Marriage customs differ between regions. Choose for each check whether it is allowed, shown as a warning the member must confirm (recorded in the audit log), or blocked. A state without its own row uses the default. When the two families are in states with different rules, the stricter one applies. Marrying an ancestor, a sibling or a parallel cousin is always blocked.
rules.note: Confirm these with the state Mahasabhas before relying on them.

merge.title: Merge a duplicate record into this one
merge.intro: Use this when the same person was entered twice. This record ({code}) is kept. The duplicate's parents, children, marriages, photo, membership requests and login move here, its empty details fill gaps in this one, and its name is kept as an alias. Its old link and member code will open this record. This can't be undone from the site.

legal.notConfigured: The organisation's name and the Grievance Officer's contact details have not been published yet. Until they are, use the grievance form below.
legal.englishApplies: The full text below is in English for now, and the English text is the one that applies.
privacySummary: We collect your account details, your membership request and the family-tree records you and your family add – nothing like Aadhaar, bank details or location, and no trackers.
Only verified members see the trees; children and anyone who withdraws consent are shown as "Private" outside the family.
Your data is never sold or used for advertising. Hosting and database providers process it for us, outside India (Singapore).
You can see, correct, dispute or erase your record, withdraw consent and complain – answered within 30 days.
One sign-in cookie only. SMS code logs are deleted after 30 days.
termsSummary: For Arya Vysya community members aged 18 and over; membership is endorsed locally and confirmed by the district in-charge.
Add only your real relatives with true details; respect anyone who asks not to be included.
Some changes go for review; if a record is wrong, raise a dispute.
No false information, harassment, or copying other people's details.
The marriage check is a reference, not a decision – families and elders decide.
childSafetySummary: Under-18s (and people with no birth year who are not married or parents) are "Private" outside the family.
They become visible only when a parent consents, and a parent can withdraw it at any time.
Only a parent can add a child's photo; it is hidden by default.
No tracking, advertising or messaging; children cannot register.
Worried about a child? Use the grievance form – child-safety reports come first. In danger: police 112, Childline 1098.
grievanceSummary: Ask to see, correct or erase your data, withdraw consent, nominate someone, or complain – no account needed.
You get a reference number straight away and an answer within 30 days.
Child-safety reports are dealt with first.
If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
